sql.if: WITH RECURSIVE selected_categories(id) AS ( SELECT id FROM md_product_category WHERE tenant_id=#{__verifiedTenant} AND id=UUID_TO_BIN(#{query.category}) UNION DISTINCT SELECT child.id FROM md_product_category child JOIN selected_categories parent ON child.parent_id=parent.id WHERE child.tenant_id=#{__verifiedTenant} )

mapper.select: SELECT BIN_TO_UUID(id) id,BIN_TO_UUID(organization_id) organizationId,code,name,product_form productForm,status,structure_state structureState,draft_archived_at archivedAt,version,updated_at updatedAt FROM md_product_v1 ORDER BY code,id LIMIT #{query.size} OFFSET #{query.offset}

SELECT r.data_type,r.numeric_scale,BIN_TO_UUID(r.id) revisionId FROM md_product_category_config_item ci JOIN md_product_template_item i ON i.tenant_id=ci.tenant_id AND i.id=ci.template_item_id JOIN md_product_attribute_revision r ON r.tenant_id=ci.tenant_id AND r.id=ci.attribute_revision_id WHERE ci.tenant_id=#{__verifiedTenant} AND ci.config_id=UUID_TO_BIN(#{config}) AND ci.template_item_id=UUID_TO_BIN(#{item}) AND i.searchable=TRUE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM md_product_attribute_option WHERE tenant_id=#{__verifiedTenant} AND revision_id=UUID_TO_BIN(#{revision}) AND id=UUID_TO_BIN(#{option})
